title: Turn a model into a system
outcome: Package a local prediction service and an evaluation harness, code that measures model behavior consistently.

blocks.body: Question: Can another engineer trust and run your model?
Mathematics: Study numerical stability, data contracts, profiling, test design, and distribution shift through your own system.
Dataset: Reuse the frozen soccer datasets and splits. For reproduction, use the selected paper’s public data if feasible; otherwise label the soccer experiment as an adaptation.
Reading: Use existing software skills. Spend time on ML-specific failure modes rather than introductory web development.

blocks.title: Anthropic research
blocks.note: Select a recent public article about evaluations or model behavior. Follow its paper or methods link and record limitations.

blocks.title: Anthropic careers
blocks.note: Compare your evidence with a current engineering role. Requirements change. This curriculum does not guarantee a role or a credential.

blocks.body: Challenge: Debug a failing prediction without an AI agent writing the fix. Explain how you would detect changing input data.

tasks.prompt: Package preprocessing and model weights together. Add a command that reproduces evaluation from saved data.
